text:
Priya: CI turned red on main after the merge earlier, pre-commit hooks failing on mypy + rustfmt. saw in the job: `build-and-check / precommit` -> exit 1. anyone on call?

Ben: looking now — I merged a small typing fix but ran pre-commit locally and it passed. Which job id?

Priya: job id 4921 on github actions, workflow: `ci/full-checks`. Quick paste of the failing part:```
+ mypy src/redwood/cli --disallow-untyped-defs
src/redwood/cli/runner.py:123: error: Function is missing a return type annotation  [no-return-annotation]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 120 source files)
+ rustfmt --check crates/runtime/src/lib.rs
Diff in crates/runtime/src/lib.rs at line 210
```

Jamal: that looks like a combo failure — mypy complaining about a new function, and rustfmt hit because of a line ending or formatting drift. Could be a pre-commit version mismatch across CI vs local.

Marta: is the runner.py change from Ben's change? @Ben can you paste the function signature?

Ben: yep, it's the new `def start_worker(pool):` I added. Locally I had `-> None` but maybe I forgot to push the annotated version. Checking commit... hmm my repo shows `def start_worker(pool):` without return type. I must have missed it in the last push, sorry. will push quick fix.

Priya: cool. for rustfmt, I've seen CI use rustfmt 1.5 while some folks have 1.6. If it's just formatting, we can rerun after the mypy fix.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by Priya for job 4921 — queued.

Jamal: to avoid wasting cycles, can we bisect to confirm PR that introduced rustfmt diff? If Ben's fix addresses mypy, rerun will show if rustfmt still fails. If it does, we bisect between last-green (2012348600) and current.

Priya: agreed. Ben please push the typed signature and then comment here when pushed. If CI still fails, we'll ask the CI team for a quick bisect job.

Ben: pushed commit 9f3a2c4 with `def start_worker(pool) -> None:` and a tiny docstring. pinged the workflow with a rerun.

ci-bot: Job 4921 re-run started. status: running.

Marta: if this ends up being rustfmt only, we should add a CI hint in the PR template reminding to run `rustup component add rustfmt && cargo fmt -- --check`. Also maybe pin rustfmt version in the toolchain file.

Priya: good idea. follow-up issue created: #DEVX-487 (follow-up: pin rustfmt in infra).

ci-bot: Job 4921 completed: failure. Summary: mypy: OK, rustfmt: FAIL (crates/runtime/src/lib.rs changed).

Jamal: OK that's isolated to rustfmt. I'll kick off a bisect job across merges between 2012348600..2012349999 and run `cargo fmt -- --check` to find the culprit. If someone on the runtime side has a pending formatting PR, please rebase.

Ben: thanks — my bad on the type. let me know if i can help with the bisect.

Priya: thanks team. action items: Ben pushed fix (mypy green), Jamal to bisect rustfmt and file a regression PR to either reformat or pin toolchain. I'll keep an eye on follow-ups. :thumbsup:
